headline: One chat window, like Claude Code
pill: one chat window, with everything else in the history
summary: Turnhuddle is now a single chat window, as in Claude Code. The separate Conversations list is gone: your past conversations live in the history behind the clock, where you can bookmark, archive and restore them.

highlights.title: Everything in the history
highlights.text: Open the history from the clock in the chat header. Bookmarked conversations come first, then recent ones, each with its age, rounds and outcome. Hover a row for **Bookmark** and **Archive**; **Show archived** lists archived conversations, and picking one restores and opens it. **Continue from a Claude Code or Codex session…** is at the end of the list.
highlights.alt: The conversation history over the Turnhuddle chat, with bookmark and archive buttons on the highlighted row and Show archived at the bottom

improvements: The Turnhuddle sidebar has just the chat; the duplicate New and Stop icons in the view's title bar are gone, since the chat header and composer have them.
